principles.tailwind: layout, spacing, responsive utilities and simple state utilities
principles.tokens: brand colors, typography scales, spacing scales, radii, shadows and motion values
principles.effects: isolated visual effects loaded only by pages that use them

rules: Do not add new Tailwind-like utility classes to custom CSS.
Do not add new upgrade or patch stylesheets.
New reusable UI must have one documented owner.
Effect styles must not redefine global layout or typography.
Legacy files are consolidated only with visual-regression evidence.
